To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

chemical dissolution of Cd1−x Znx Te is controlled by the diffusion of iodine atoms in the solution, and that iodine–methanoletching is the most promising method of chemical polishing for Cd1−x Zn x Te.
iodine–methano etching solutions provide a better surface quality for CdZnTe substrates as compared to bromine–methano solutions.
the iodine–methano etchants provide the highest quality surface layer on CdTe and CZT crystals.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a chemical polishing method for CdTe and Cd0.9Zn0.1Te crystals with a minimum of surface damage and a minimum number of steps in the technological process.
the study of the chemical polishing of Cd1−xTe and Cd1–xZnxTe single crystals in iodine–methanolic solutions.
the development of chemical polishing of CdTe and (CdZn)Te single crystals and the investigation of the nature of chemical dissolution of these crystals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the iodine-containing etchants can be used for the preparation of Cd1−xTe1−ySey and Cd1−yZn1+yTe surfaces with high quality.
iodine-based etchants are more efficient than bromine-based ones in the chemical polishing of CdTe and (Cd,Zn)Te surfaces.
the iodine-based etchant provides the best surface morphology and quality of the CdTe and Cd(Zn)Te crystals.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the iodine-containing polishing etchant is a promising method for chemical polishing of CdTe and ZnCdTe surfaces with different crystallographic orientations and for preparation of high-quality CdTe and ZnTe surfaces for subsequent epitaxial growth.
iodine–methanolic etchants provide the best quality surfaces for Cd1−xTeZnTe crystals.
the iodine–methanoletchants are more efficient for chemical polishing of CdTe and ZnTe-based compounds than bromine–methanolsolutions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
iodine–metholan etchants are promising for chemical polishing of CdTe and ZnTe crystals.
iodine–metholan etchants are suitable for polishing Cd1−x−ZnxTe with different orientations.
iodine-containing etching solutions are promising for chemical polishing of CdTe and related compounds.
